evidence_gaps: No fresh runtime forensics: evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS and generated_epoch is zero.
No realised money-weighted NET P&L by strategy, chain, notional and market regime.
No complete attribution of fees, slippage, price impact, priority fees, rent/account effects and failed-execution costs.
No quote-to-fill or quote-to-counterfactual-outcome latency distribution.
No execution funnel separating quote, simulation, signing, submission, confirmation, settlement and unwind failures.
No STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss-labelled dataset.
No independent out-of-sample windows, confidence intervals, drawdown series or concentration analysis.
No Solana current executable-edge feature adapter or dynamic fee evidence.
No EVM pinned-state counterfactual outcomes across gas and congestion regimes.

Before any promotion: supply fresh sanitised runtime evidence covering completed round trips, all-in costs, failed-attempt costs, chain-specific execution diagnostics, non-overlapping out-of-sample results and money-weighted NET P&L.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative cost reserves may reject genuinely profitable opportunities; this should be measured as opportunity cost, not relaxed without evidence.

evidence.detail: Common eligibility subtracts fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve and rejects stale, illiquid or unsellable observations.
Explicitly states that strategies must not manufacture trades when no positive edge exists.
SHADOW evaluation is non-signing and marks quote simulations as insufficient promotion evidence.

proposals.expected_effect: Avoids structurally negative trades and preserves capital during markets with no executable edge.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent time windows and 100 eligible-or-near-threshold observations per chain across at least three volatility/congestion regimes.
proposals.rationale: This policy aligns selection with durable money-weighted NET P&L rather than trade count or win rate.
proposals.shadow_test: For each chain and notional bucket, compare eligible versus rejected signals using immutable decision-time quotes and later executable unwind quotes. Include DEX fees, measured slippage and price impact, EVM gas and priority fees, Solana base/priority fees and account/rent effects. Stop if any safety field is absent or if rejected observations cannot be reconstructed without look-ahead.
proposals.strategy: Common positive executable-edge and abstention policy

proposals.downside_risk: Quotes may overstate fill quality and repeated polling may create correlated samples or rate-limit failures.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events intentionally set gross edge, fees, liquidity and sellability to zero and outcome_available=false because current executable edge is unavailable.
SHADOW entry checks Jupiter round-trip loss and deterioration, but P&L uses fixed estimated entry and exit fees.
Runtime forensics are missing, so actual priority fees, quote-to-fill deterioration, failed execution costs and realised outcomes cannot be validated.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces falsifiable money-weighted SHADOW evidence and separates adverse market movement from quote/RPC/simulation infrastructure failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 independent signals, 100 complete round-trip outcomes, 30 calendar days, three congestion regimes and multiple notional buckets; report confidence intervals and leader/mint concentration.
proposals.rationale: Solana economics require decision-time forward and reverse quotes at the intended size, dynamic priority-fee estimates, token-account/rent effects and latency-aware outcomes. Historical leader returns or win ratios do not establish copyable edge.
proposals.shadow_test: Record immutable decision-time Jupiter routes and costs, then obtain scheduled executable unwind quotes without broadcasting. Compute NET SOL after entry/exit price impact, slippage, base and priority fees, ATA/rent effects and failure costs. Label a completed negative economic outcome STRATEGY/MARKET; label unavailable quote, RPC, simulation or route construction faults EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. Stop on missing cost fields, route inconsistency, more than 5% infrastructure-failure rate, or non-positive money-weighted out-of-sample NET P&L.

proposals.downside_risk: Counterfactual fills remain estimates and can be biased by block selection, MEV and unavailable historical state.

evidence.detail: EVM outcome availability currently means exact quote plus simulation and safety flags, not a later realised or counterfactual outcome.
quote_simulated_net_base is derived directly from the signal's expected net-edge estimate and is explicitly not promotion evidence.
Execution protects minimum output with conservative gas reserves and mandatory final simulation, demonstrating that quote-time and broadcast-time economics can differ.

proposals.expected_effect: Reveals whether apparent arbitrage, momentum or learned-route edge survives congestion, latency and failed-transaction costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 300 observations and 100 complete route outcomes per EVM chain, spanning 30 days, three gas-price regimes and at least three notional buckets.
proposals.rationale: A score calculated from the same quote used to select a route cannot prove persistence. EVM evidence must measure later executable results under chain-specific gas markets, reverts, priority bidding and route decay.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay each decision against pinned block-state or contemporaneous follow-up quotes using the original notional. Deduct pool fees, builder payments, realised price impact, slippage, EIP-1559 base/priority fees and gas consumed by failures. Classify a successfully executable negative result as STRATEGY/MARKET and simulation/RPC/revert/confirmation faults as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. Stop if state cannot be pinned, failure costs are omitted, or out-of-sample money-weighted NET P&L is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Stricter provenance and sample requirements delay promotion and may leave sparse strategies in SHADOW for long periods.

evidence.detail: Aggregated evaluation can consume recorded net_profit and execution_failures, but does not enforce provenance, non-overlapping windows, chain/notional segmentation or completeness of cost fields.
Profit factor is derived from gross profit and gross loss while fees and slippage are separate, so it is not itself a fully cost-adjusted promotion statistic.
The SHADOW store correctly fixes promotion_evidence to false, providing a safe basis for stricter realised-outcome provenance.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents correlated quote simulations or incomplete accounting from being interpreted as deployable edge.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent windows, 100 completed economic outcomes per strategy-chain pair, 30 days, and no single asset, leader or route contributing more than 25% of gross profit.
proposals.rationale: Promotion evidence should be based on independent, fully costed, money-weighted outcomes, with infrastructure failure rates reported separately. Raw wins and pre-cost profit factor can otherwise overstate durability.
proposals.shadow_test: Create a research-only scorecard that accepts only non-overlapping, out-of-sample outcomes with explicit notional and complete chain-specific costs. Require positive money-weighted NET P&L with a conservative confidence bound above zero, acceptable drawdown and separately bounded infrastructure-failure rate. Stop and mark evidence invalid if provenance, costs or loss classification are missing.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy from current quote/simulation scorecards.
rejected_ideas.reason: They contain no realised out-of-sample outcomes and are explicitly marked as non-promotion evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use leader win rate or raw trade wins as the Solana entry objective.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores loss magnitude, copy latency, sellability, priority fees and price impact.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower liquidity, sellability, simulation or minimum-edge gates to increase participation.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades do not improve money-weighted NET P&L and would weaken fail-closed execution protection.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat RPC, simulation, signing or confirmation failures as strategy market losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: These are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures and require separate rates, costs and remediation.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository correctly supports abstention and separates non-signing SHADOW evaluation from protected execution, but no fresh runtime forensics exist and the current SHADOW layer lacks realised out-of-sample outcome attribution. Solana observations deliberately contain no executable edge estimate; EVM observations are quote/simulation estimates rather than realised returns. Profitability, CANARY readiness and LIVE readiness are therefore unproven. Future evaluation must classify negative realised NET P&L after all costs as STRATEGY/MARKET loss, while RPC, simulation, signing, submission, confirmation and settlement faults remain EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
